How to Obtain: Rewarded for defeating The Ravager or the Totem Father.
Obtained after dealing 5000 damage to enemy armor.

First, it is required that you obtain the Twisted Mask (see the Armor checklist). Then, find the Wailing Tree encounter, but do not attack the Wailing Tree. Instead, the Twisted Mask allows you to speak with it, and you will be rewarded with this trait if you do. Warning: If you do this event in co-op, only 1 player will be able to obtain this trait from the encounter.

Obtain the Cryptolith Sigil from the Iskal Queen, then use it on the Cryptolith Tower. This must be done 2 separate times (re-rolling the world in between each use). After the second use, you will be rewarded with this trait.
Rewarded for defeating The Thrall or Canker.
Obtained after vaulting 50 times.

Find Brabus in The Depot dungeon while in a co-op game. He will give you the option of fighting your teammate. The winner of the fight will be rewarded with this trait. Warning: Only 1 player can obtain this trait from the encounter. Also, if the first person to talk to Brabus has the Pocket Watch item, they will not get the option to fight a teammate.
Obtain the Cryptolith Sigil from the Iskal Queen, then use it on the Cryptolith Tower. After the first use, you will be rewarded with this trait.
Obtained after killing 100 enemies with explosive damage.

Retreive the Ward 13 Keycard from the Founder's Hideout (a location on Earth). Open the door on level B2 in Ward 13 using the Keycard. Walk straight down the hallway and enter the second door on the left (labeled "Dr. Santiago Itsaso"). Activate the tape recorder on the desk. When it finishes playing, you will obtain this trait.
New characters begin with this trait.
Destroy all of the hives during the "Circlet Hatchery" event without getting hit by any of the wisps.
Rewarded for defeating Ixillis.
Obtained after killing 150 enemies with Weak Spot Damage.
Obtained after acquiring 25 weapon mods.
Rewarded for defeating the Iskal Queen.

This requires 1 or 2 other players. Find the Fetid Pools dungeon and obtain 3 Acid Cleaned Keys. To obtain an Acid Cleaned Key, you must find and wear a Rusted Amulet, then crouch in one of the acid pools. Once you have 3 keys, open the door that accesses the stairs up. Then open the door to the upstairs room. Use the final key to open the door that leads into the chamber holding the Hero's Ring. Picking up the Hero's Ring will reward this trait.
Rewarded for defeating The Unclean One.

Find the Stuck Merchant. Get the Strange Curio from the back of her wagon. It can be used to open the door to the Guardian Shrine dungeon. At the end of the dungeon, you may encounter the Root Horror, which will run away after being reduced to 50% health. Return to the Stuck Merchant's wagon, where the Root Horror will reappear. Defeat the Root Horror to be rewarded with this trait.
Acquired upon obtaining 10 ranged weapons.
Rewarded for defeating Brudvaak, the Rider and Vargr, the Warg.
Acquired upon killing 100 enemies with summoned creatures.
Acquired upon entering The Labyrinth for the first time.
Rewarded for defeating the Undying King.
Rewarded for defeating Harsgaard, Root Harbinger.

You must be infected with the Parasite effect from an Iskal Infector. This allows you to purchase this trait from Mar'Gosh for 1 Opalescent Shell. The Opalescent Shell can be obtained from the Mudling Queen Beetle during the "Abandoned Throne" event. There is a very small percentage chance to spawn this event with each beetle kill (the non-hostile beetles around the throne). It is recommended to focus on the white beetles, as they have smaller health pools.
Rewarded for defeating the Dreamer/Nightmare.
Obtained after successfully defending the Root Mother.

You must be infected with the Parasite effect from an Iskal Infector. Speak with the Iskal Queen and agree to help her. She will give you an Iskal Vial. Go to the graveyard. Crouch and stealthily approach the Graveyard Elf's cauldron to avoid waking her up. Interact with the cauldron to use the Iskal Vial, which will unlock this trait.
Rewarded for defeating The Ent or Singe.
Acquired upon leveling any non-boss melee weapon to level 20.
Rewarded for defeating Claviger or The Harrow.
Acquired upon reviving teammates 10 times.

Find the Tarnished Ring, which spawns randomly. Return it to Reggie and ask him to talk about himself. Exhaust his dialogue until you are given the option to give him the Tarnished Ring. Give him the ring to acquire this trait. Alternatively, you can also obtain this trait by picking up 50,000 Scrap.
Given to the Hunter archtype by Ace in Ward 13. Alternatively, it can also be obtained as a reward for completing the event "Hunter's Hideout" in the Hidden Grotto dungeon.
Acquired after completing the "Rescue the Krall Baby" event in Wuthering Keep or The Wild Reach.
Obtained upon getting 100 kills per weapon for 10 different ranged weapons (for a total of 1000 kills).
Given to the Ex-Cultist archtype by Ace in Ward 13. It can also be obtained as a reward for completing the event "Supply Run" in the Sorrow's Pass dungeon.
Acquired after being downed 10 times by Friendly Fire Damage.
Obtained by playing the "Song of the Guardian" on any of the bells in Yaesha. The correct bell sequence is 1-1-3-4-1-1-3-2.
Acquired upon joining another player's game or having another player join your game for the first time.
Acquired upon applying 100 status effects on enemies.
Acquired after speaking with Navun at the Shrine of the Immortals.
Acquired upon leveling any ranged weapon to level 20.
Acquired upon curing 25 status effects using consumables.
New characters begin with this trait.
Given to the Scrapper archtype by Ace in Ward 13. It can also be obtained as a reward for completing the event "A Tale of Two Liz's" in The Warren dungeon.
Obtained after being revived 10 times by other players.
Acquired after completing the Ward Prime quest line.
Acquired upon entering Rhom for the first time.
